headline: Approved a $7,400 McGrath estimate and the 2027 calendar dates.
summary: The meeting also reviewed finances, showing $150,661.32 invested as of September 2026. Monument repairs were discussed, with hopes that some will be finished before cold weather.
decisions: Approved the $7,400 McGrath estimate, with the work still waiting to be completed.

decision_evidence.quote: McGrath estimate of $7,400 is approved — just waiting on work to be completed.
